column3: Dr. Vance earned her Ph.D. in cell biology from the Northwind Institute and completed a postdoctoral fellowship in tumor immunology. Her laboratory studies how extracellular vesicles shape the tumor microenvironment in pancreatic and breast cancer, with a focus on stromal crosstalk. She joined the faculty in 2016 and directs the Institute's Vesicle Biology Core. Contact: evance@example.edu, 555-0112.

Dr. Oyelaran leads the exosome isolation and characterization program. He holds a Ph.D. in biochemistry and has twelve years of experience in vesicle purification, nanoparticle tracking analysis, and proteomic profiling. He is the person to ask about ultracentrifugation, gradient separation, and anything that has gone wrong with the NTA instrument. Contact: moyelaran@example.edu, 555-0134.

Dr. Venkataraman studies fibroblast heterogeneity using single-cell RNA sequencing. She maintains the lab's scRNA-seq pipeline and is the first point of contact for library preparation, sequencing submission, and questions about the analysis environment on the compute cluster. Contact: pvenkataraman@example.edu, 555-0147.

Tomas is a fourth-year graduate student working on macrophage polarization in response to tumor-derived vesicles. He runs the lab's flow cytometry panels and manages the antibody inventory. Contact: tlindqvist@example.edu, 555-0158.

Grace manages ordering, reagent inventory, equipment maintenance schedules, and onboarding for new lab members. She is the correct first contact for purchasing, cell bank access, freezer space, waste pickup scheduling, and safety training records. Contact: gabiodun@example.edu, 555-0121.

Daniel supports computational analysis across the lab, including RNA-seq processing, differential expression, and maintenance of the shared analysis containers. He is the contact for cluster accounts, pipeline failures, and data storage requests. Contact: dokafor@example.edu, 555-0163.

Sofia handles routine cell culture, mycoplasma testing, and cryopreservation of the cell bank. She is the contact for cell line requests, culture contamination questions, and media preparation. Contact: smarchetti@example.edu, 555-0129.
